title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_202036 gives the title. A Wayback copy (14 Mar 2026) of India Code handle 16823 shows 'Act ID: 202036 Act Number: 36 Enactment Date: 2020-09-28'. Commencement on 21 Nov 2025 comes from the PIB release seen in search results, alongside the IRC and OSH commencement footnotes on India Code. The SS Code's own s.1 footnote is outside the retrieved 2 KB and was not read.
notes: Listed here for maternity benefit (the Maternity Benefit Act 1961 is subsumed).
